page.overview:
Who is Ashrah?

Ashrah (Japanese: アシュラ Ashura) is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A demoness who desires absolution from the Netherrealm, Ashrah slays demons with an enchanted Kriss sword called Datusha to purge the evil from her soul.

Ashrah made her debut in Mortal Kombat: Deception. She would return as one of the many playable characters in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.

A new version of Ashrah appears in Mortal Kombat 1 as a playable character as well as a supporting character in the game's Story Mode, marking Ashrah's playable return to the franchise in over 16 years.

Despite having the appearance of an elegant, old-fashioned, attractive young woman, Ashrah is actually a demon from the Netherrealm. She dresses completely in white, however and appears as a tall, mysterious woman, a blend between aristocracy and innocence. This is because she tires of her former life in the Netherrealm and wants to escape.
